units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b:13">Snh. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>אבל אפיקורוס … דפ׳ טפי</he> but with a Jewish sceptic you must surely not argue, for he will become only bolder by it.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 60a:21">Ib. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>מי פְקִירֵי כולי האי</he> are they (Jews) so bold (as to blaspheme God)?; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 22:4">Targ. Y. Ex. XXII, 4</cite> (ed. Amst. <he>יִפְקַר</he>; ed. Vien. <he>יפקד</he>, corr. acc.; h. text <he>יבער</he>).

senses.gloss: to declare free. Ib. XXIII, 11 (ed. Amst. Pe.; ed. Vien. ותפקד, corr. acc.; h. text ונטש׳).—
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 44b:6">Succ. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>אַפְקַר זיתיא וכ׳</he> declare thy olives free for the benefit of the poor.
<cite ref="Berakhot 47a">Ber. 47ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אי בעי מַפְקַר וכ׳</he> if he chooses, he may renounce ownership of his property, and be a poor man &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 30b:7">B. Mets. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>לכולי עלמא אַפְקַרְנְהוּ וכ׳</he> I declared them free for all people but not for thee, (v. infra).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 30b:9">Ib.</cite> <he>לכ״ע אַפְקְרִינְהוּ</he> he declared them indeed free for all.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 68b:13">Ib. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>אַפְקוּרֵי מַפְקִיר להו</he> presumably he has renounced ownership of them.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 16a:9">M. Kat. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>מַפְקְרִינָן נכסיה</he> we (the court) declare his property ownerless; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 13b:2">Ḥull. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>אשתו לא מַפְקַר</he> his own wife will he (the Samaritan) not give up to prostitution, v. infra.—Part. pass. <he>מַפְקַר</he>.
B. Mets. 30ᵇ לכ״ע מ׳ וכ׳ Ms. M. (Ms. F. מִיפְּקַר Ithpe.) it is made free to all, but not &c.

senses.gloss: to behave irreverently, disrespectfully. M. Kat. l. c. אי מִתְפְּקַר בשליחא וכ׳ if he treats the messenger of the court with disrespect. Ib. ההוא טבחא דאית׳ וכ׳ a butcher behaved irreverently towards R. &c.

units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 82a:8">Snh. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>נשייהו ודאי לא מִיפְקְרֵי</he> their (the Samaritans’) wives will surely not prostitute themselves; v. supra.
